item.title: VertKleen LAM3 vs Wet & Forget: compare the finished area
item.description: Wet & Forget is built for gradual stain removal. LAM3 adds long-dwell cleaning, Purgo support, and HMIS 0-0-0 across the exterior-care program.

item.description: CLR PRO MAX is built for heavy descaling. HCR adds HMIS 0-0-0, more scale-removal capacity than hydrochloric acid, and up to 280× less steel corrosion.

item.title: Industrial descaling without the mineral-acid burden
item.description: HCR and Descaler remove stubborn mineral buildup with HMIS 0-0-0 handling, up to 280× less steel corrosion, and more scale-removal capacity than hydrochloric acid.
